Flash sale inventory: daily challenge, 2027-02-06

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-02-06: Flash sale inventory. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

At noon a hot item goes on sale with only a few thousand units. A huge crowd arrives in the same minute and everyone taps Buy. Stock must never go below zero, nobody should be charged for an item that is gone, and the site must not fall over.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
